```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(glue)
library(tidytext)
library(irr)
library(psych)
```

```{r}
annotations <- read.csv(here("data/completed_annotations/activity_annotations.csv"))
df_cleaned <- read.csv(here("data/all_contexts_cleaned.csv"))
annotators = c("elenahc", "m1deng")
```

```{r}
cleaned_annotations <- annotations |> filter(annotatorName %in% annotators) 
main_annotations <- cleaned_annotations |> filter(isTraining != "true")

main_annotations$all_activities <- apply(main_annotations, 1, function(row) {
  acts <- unlist(row[c("primaryActivity", str_trim(paste0("otherActivities.", 0:2, ".")))])
  acts <- acts[!is.na(acts) & acts != ""]
  list(acts)  
})
```

# confusion matrices
-- anyone interacting
```{r}
# Reshape data to wide format for pairwise comparisons
interaction_wide <- main_annotations %>%
  select(videoFilename, annotatorName, anyoneInteracting) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = annotatorName,
    values_from = anyoneInteracting,
    names_prefix = "interaction_"
  )

primary_activity_wide <- main_annotations %>%
  select(videoFilename, annotatorName, primaryActivity) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = annotatorName,
    values_from = primaryActivity,
    names_prefix = "primary_"
  )

# Get all unique categories
all_interactions <- unique(main_annotations$anyoneInteracting)
all_primary_activities <- unique(main_annotations$primaryActivity)

print("=== ANYONE INTERACTING ===")

create_pairwise_comparisons_single <- function(data, columns) {
  # Create all possible pairs without duplicates
  pairs <- combn(columns, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  
  # For each pair, create comparison in one direction only
  map_dfr(pairs, function(pair) {
    data.frame(
      actual = data[[pair[1]]],
      predicted = data[[pair[2]]]
    )
  })
}

interaction_confusion <- create_pairwise_comparisons_single(
  interaction_wide,
  c("interaction_elenahc", "interaction_m1deng")
) %>%
  create_confusion_data() %>%
  add_proportions_and_pmi(all_interactions, min_count = 0) %>%
  order_by_max_pmi()

plot_confusion_counts(
  interaction_confusion,
  "Anyone Interacting: Counts",
  "m1deng", #x-axis: predicted
  "elenahc" #y-axis: actual
)

plot_confusion_proportions(
  interaction_confusion,
  "Anyone Interacting: Proportions",
  "m1deng", #x-axis: predicted
  "elenahc" #y-axis: actual
)

interaction_matrix <- interaction_wide %>%
  select(interaction_elenahc, interaction_m1deng) %>%
  as.matrix()

kappa_interaction <- kappa2(interaction_matrix)
print(paste("Cohen's Kappa for anyoneInteracting:", round(kappa_interaction$value, 3)))
```
```{r}
# 2. PRIMARY ACTIVITY Confusion Matrices
```

# 3. EXPANDED ACTIVITIES (Primary + Other Activities)
```{r}
print("=== EXPANDED ACTIVITIES (Primary + Other) ===")


# For confusion matrix with expanded activities, we need to check overlap
# This creates binary agreement: do any activities overlap between annotators?
expanded_wide <- main_annotations %>%
  select(videoFilename, annotatorName, all_activities) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = annotatorName,
    values_from = all_activities,
    names_prefix = "activities_"
  )

# Calculate set-based agreement
expanded_agreement <- expanded_wide %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    overlap = length(intersect(activities_elenahc, activities_m1deng)) > 0,
    elenahc_count = length(activities_elenahc),
    m1deng_count = length(activities_m1deng)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# For confusion matrix with expanded activities, treat primary as "actual"
# and check if it appears in the other annotator's expanded list
expanded_comparison <- expanded_annotations %>%
  select(videoFilename, annotatorName, primaryActivity, all_activities) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = annotatorName,
    values_from = c(primaryActivity, all_activities),
    names_sep = "_"
  )

# Create bidirectional comparisons
expanded_confusion_data <- bind_rows(
  expanded_comparison %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      actual = primaryActivity_elenahc,
      predicted = if(primaryActivity_elenahc %in% all_activities_m1deng) 
        primaryActivity_elenahc else "other"
    ),
  expanded_comparison %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      actual = primaryActivity_m1deng,
      predicted = if(primaryActivity_m1deng %in% all_activities_elenahc) 
        primaryActivity_m1deng else "other"
    )
) %>%
  ungroup()

# Get all activities for confusion matrix
all_activities_expanded <- c(unique(main_annotations$primaryActivity), "other")

expanded_confusion <- expanded_confusion_data %>%
  create_confusion_data() %>%
  add_proportions_and_pmi(all_activities_expanded) %>%
  order_by_max_pmi()

plot_confusion_counts(
  expanded_confusion,
  "Expanded Activities: Counts (Primary vs All Activities)",
  "Found in Other's List",
  "Primary Activity"
)

plot_confusion_proportions(
  expanded_confusion,
  "Expanded Activities: Proportions (Primary vs All Activities)",
  "Found in Other's List",
  "Primary Activity"
)

plot_confusion_pmi(
  expanded_confusion,
  "Expanded Activities: PMI (Primary vs All Activities)",
  "Found in Other's List",
  "Primary Activity"
)
```

```{r}
# Calculate agreement for each video across all measures
video_difficulty <- main_annotations %>%
  # Add video order (sorted by videoFilename descending, then index+1)
  arrange(desc(videoFilename)) %>%
  mutate(video_order = row_number()) %>%
  arrange(videoFilename) %>%
  
  # Group by video to calculate agreement metrics
  group_by(videoFilename) %>%
  summarise(
    video_order = first(video_order),
    
    # Agreement on anyoneInteracting
    interaction_agreement = ifelse(
      n() == 2,
      as.numeric(anyoneInteracting[1] == anyoneInteracting[2]),
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    # Agreement on primaryActivity
    primary_agreement = ifelse(
      n() == 2,
      as.numeric(primaryActivity[1] == primaryActivity[2]),
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    # primary + others overlap
    expanded_agreement = ifelse(
      n() == 2,
      {
        activities_1 <- unlist(all_activities[1])
        activities_2 <- unlist(all_activities[2])
        round(as.numeric(length(intersect(activities_1, activities_2)) / max(length(activities_1), length(activities_2))),2)
      },
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    n_annotators = n()
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # Calculate composite difficulty score (higher = easier)
  mutate(
    # Sum of agreements (0-3, where 3 = perfect agreement on all)
    composite_agreement = interaction_agreement + primary_agreement + expanded_agreement,
    
    # Difficulty rank (1 = hardest, higher = easier)
    difficulty_rank = rank(composite_agreement, ties.method = "first")
  ) %>%
  
  # Sort by difficulty (easiest to hardest)
  arrange(desc(composite_agreement), videoFilename)

# View summary
print("=== VIDEO DIFFICULTY SUMMARY ===")
print(paste("Total videos:", nrow(video_difficulty)))
print(paste("Videos with perfect agreement (all 3):", sum(video_difficulty$composite_agreement == 3, na.rm = TRUE)))

# Show distribution
print("\nAgreement distribution:")
video_difficulty %>%
  group_by(composite_agreement) %>%
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    percentage = round(n() / nrow(video_difficulty) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  print()

# View easiest videos
video_difficulty %>%
  arrange(desc(composite_agreement)) %>%
  select(videoFilename, video_order, interaction_agreement, 
         primary_agreement, expanded_agreement, composite_agreement) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  print()

# View hardest videos
video_difficulty %>%
  arrange(composite_agreement) |>
  select(videoFilename, video_order, interaction_agreement, 
         primary_agreement, expanded_agreement, composite_agreement) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  print()
```

```{r}
# Visualize difficulty distribution
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(video_difficulty, aes(x = composite_agreement)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  geom_text(stat = 'count', aes(label = after_stat(count)), vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Video Difficulty Distribution",
    subtitle = "Based on number of measures with annotator agreement",
    x = "Number of Measures with Agreement",
    y = "Number of Videos"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,3,by=0.5))+
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```
